rationale: HarmonyImportSpecifierDependency and HarmonyExportImportedSpecifierDependency both `extends HarmonyImportDependency` (imported via `require("./HarmonyImportDependency")`), and their serialize overrides call `super.serialize(context)`, which resolves to HarmonyImportDependency.serialize. Ariadne recorded these super calls as unresolved with `no_parent_class`, so it failed to link the CommonJS-required superclass (HarmonyImportDependency.js also adds properties to module.exports). Inherited dispatch from makeSerializable's `obj.serialize(context)` for the subclasses that do not override it is a further runtime path. No in-scope rule covers super-call or superclass resolution.
prior_verdicts_assessment: Both prior fp-novel verdicts are correct; the second identifies the decisive unresolved super.serialize calls, and the first identifies a valid additional inherited-dispatch path.
